Join us in this role where you’ll lead programme governance, portfolio reviews and business performance reporting across our Generation business of more than 10 GW. You’ll connect stakeholders, performance data and improvement initiatives to support effective decision-making and sustainable value creation. Through analytical insight, effective programme management and cross-functional collaboration, you’ll help strengthen business performance and deliver measurable, sustained improvements.

**Welcome to Generation

**You’ll be part of Generation Performance Management where you, together with your colleagues, will turn business data into performance insight, strengthen performance dialogue and accelerate measurable improvement. You’ll work closely with programme managers, continuous improvement specialists, finance business partners, data owners and senior leaders to strengthen governance and transparency, improve performance reporting and support decision-making across performance units and central functions.

As a team, we succeed as one by promoting curiosity, combining diverse perspectives, supporting each other’s growth, and turning complex challenges into practical solutions that deliver value for the business.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• owning and continuously improving the governance framework for Generation’s Performance Improvement Programme, ensuring clear decision gates, consistent application and effective portfolio oversight.

• leading global portfolio reviews to resolve dependencies, manage risks, prioritise resources and share knowledge across improvement programmes.

• driving the end-to-end Business Review Meeting cycle for Generation, ensuring accurate, consistent and timely performance reporting to senior leadership.

• consolidating operational, financial and programme data into clear insights and recommendations for senior decision-makers.

• analysing business performance to identify improvement opportunities and supporting the development of new or enhanced performance initiatives.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have experience in programme management, business performance management, continuous improvement, portfolio governance or related disciplines.

• demonstrate strong analytical capability and can translate complex data into actionable business insights and recommendations.

• build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and confidently challenge assumptions through a fact-based, solution-oriented approach.

• have experience coordinating work across multiple functions, balancing competing priorities and driving progress through influence and collaboration.

• bring a strong understanding of benefits realisation and can establish clear measures to track whether improvement initiatives deliver their intended value.

• preferably have experience working in energy, infrastructure or another asset-intensive industry.

Maybe you've read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don't quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

We are seeking a highly organised, strategic, and results-oriented Manager to support the CPO Office in driving the Product strategy and key business priorities.

Reporting to the Director, CPO Office, the role will translate strategic direction into actionable plans, coordinate cross-functional delivery, and ensure high-quality execution. The Manager will drive selected strategic initiatives, support governance and portfolio management, and prepare analysis and communications for senior leadership. The ideal candidate combines strong problem-solving, stakeholder management, and project management skills, with the ability to bring structure to complex topics and drive progress across teams.

**Roles & Responsibilities

**

• Support the development and execution of the Product strategy, translating priorities into clear plans, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes.

• Drive selected strategic projects and workstreams on behalf of the CPO Office, ensuring effective planning, coordination, and on-time delivery.

• Manage governance processes, leadership forums, and portfolio reviews, ensuring key decisions, actions, risks, and dependencies are clearly captured and followed through.

• Conduct strategic analysis, scenario modelling, and business assessments to support leadership decision-making and prioritisation.

• Prepare high-quality executive presentations, decision papers, business cases, and updates for senior leadership and Board reviews.

• Partner with Product, Marketing, Finance, Commercial, and other cross-functional teams to align priorities, manage dependencies, resolve issues, and accelerate execution.

• Coordinate across global, regional, and local teams to ensure strategic initiatives are commercially relevant, operationally feasible, and supported by clear accountability.

• Establish robust PMO practices and continuously improve planning, reporting, governance, and ways of working across the Product organisation.

• Support the Director in managing external consultants, research partners, and other specialist resources when required.

**Qualifications & Experience

**

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Strategy, Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree is an advantage.

• 5-8 years of experience in strategy, management consulting, business transformation, strategic PMO, product strategy, or a related field.

• Experience working in a complex, cross-functional, and international organisation.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguity and translate analysis into clear recommendations.

• Excellent project management, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience preparing executive-level materials.

• Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills, with strong attention to detail.

• Proactive, collaborative, and comfortable working at pace across multiple priorities.

**Additional Information

**

• Global Career Band 4B

Help shape a more efficient and resilient global vaccine distribution network

Can you turn complex logistics data into practical improvements?

Do you know how to challenge transport flows, strengthen supplier performance and uncover what drives distribution costs?

And would you like to build capabilities that continue to make a difference beyond your assignment?

At Bavarian Nordic, we are looking for a Global Distribution Network Optimization Lead to improve our global distribution network and strengthen the tools, insights and ways of working behind it.

This position is initially established for approximately 12–18 months to deliver priority network improvements and build a lasting capability within Global Distribution & Logistics.

**Your role

**You will assess how our distribution network performs today and identify how it can better balance cost, service, lead time, capacity and resilience. Turning network data and operational insights into a prioritized roadmap, you will work with colleagues and logistics partners to put agreed improvements into practice.

You will report to the Head of Global Distribution & Logistics. The role has no direct reports, so your impact will come through your analytical expertise, project leadership and ability to create alignment across functions.

You will collaborate closely with Distribution Leads, Global Planning, Regional Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain Compliance, Quality and the I2O Process Manager, as well as logistics service providers and carriers.

**What You Will Do

**Your responsibilities will cover three connected areas:

Optimize the distribution network

• Assess the current network and develop a prioritized optimization roadmap covering cost, service, lead time, capacity and risk.

• Analyse distribution lanes, shipment profiles, routes, transport modes and network flows to identify improvement opportunities.

• Build transparency on distribution costs and cost-to-serve to support informed decisions.

• Identify opportunities for shipment consolidation, routing improvements, changes in transport mode and network redesign.

• Lead or support the implementation of agreed changes, working with Distribution Leads to turn recurring operational issues into lasting improvements.

**Strengthen supplier strategy and performance

**

• Develop logistics supplier and carrier strategies in close collaboration with Procurement.

• Establish a supplier performance framework with clear KPIs, governance, performance reviews and improvement plans.

• Support logistics tenders, supplier selection and contract optimization.

• Work with suppliers, carriers and internal stakeholders to deliver measurable improvements in cost and service.

**Build Capabilities That Last

**

• Establish analytical tools, standards and governance that make network optimization an ongoing part of how we work.

• Support future digital ways of working, including the use of transportation management systems (TMS) to improve visibility and decision support.

• Build and transfer knowledge so that colleagues can sustain and develop the capability beyond the assignment.

**What Success Looks Like

**During the assignment, you will establish a clear network optimization roadmap and a prioritized set of improvement opportunities. You will provide better visibility of distribution costs, develop practical lane and routing recommendations, and put a supplier performance framework and strategy in place.

Success will also mean implementing changes that deliver tangible improvements in cost, service and network resilience—and leaving colleagues with the tools and knowledge to continue that work.

**What You Bring

**You have strong experience in logistics, transportation, distribution or supply chain network optimization. You understand both the commercial drivers of a distribution network and the operational realities of making changes work.

**We are looking for someone with:

**

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex data into practical business decisions.

• Experience in logistics sourcing, tenders, carrier management and supplier performance management.

• A strong commercial and cost mindset, with the ability to assess trade-offs across service, lead time, capacity and risk.

• Strong project and change management skills, including the ability to move improvements from analysis into implementation.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence across functions.

**How You Work

**You combine a strategic perspective with a practical approach. You are comfortable challenging existing arrangements but take the time to understand operational needs before recommending changes.

You create clarity around opportunities, priorities and expected benefits, and bring colleagues with you through implementation. You also share your knowledge openly, helping others take ownership of new tools and ways of working.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**This is an opportunity to deliver meaningful improvements within a defined assignment while shaping how global distribution develops over the longer term. You will influence network decisions, supplier strategies and the analytical capabilities that support reliable vaccine distribution.

At Bavarian Nordic, we work to improve and save lives through vaccines. Our culture values persistence, openness to change and collaboration. In this role, you can put those values into practice by solving complex distribution challenges and building improvements together with colleagues across the business.

**Caught your interest?

**If you are ready to take on a pivotal role in a growing organization and drive meaningful change in healthcare, apply now and join Bavarian Nordic in our mission to improve health outcomes and foster sustainable growth.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

For more information, visit _www.bavarian-nordic.com

As a Senior Planning Specialist, Global Planning, you will play a key role in strengthening and continuously improving Ambu’s global planning capabilities. You will combine data, process expertise and stakeholder collaboration to turn planning information into actionable insights that support better decisions on cost, efficiency, service, and inventory performance.

You will help shape and improve our global planning processes by identifying opportunities, challenging existing ways of working, and translating best practices into scalable solutions. Working closely with stakeholders across Global Supply Chain, you will connect global standards and strategy with effective local execution.

This is more than an analytical role. You will act as a key driver of planning excellence, helping build best-in-class planning processes and enabling smarter, more efficient and resilient ways of working across our global operations.

**Key Responsibilities

****Your mission is to improve our global planning landscape through process excellence, data-driven insights and effective change implementation.

****More Specifically, Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• 
Process Excellence: Assess and continuously improve global planning processes, identifying opportunities to increase efficiency, standardization and scalability across regions.

• 
Change & Implementation: Lead and support implementation of new processes, tools and best practices, ensuring effective adoption and sustainable change across the orgnization.

• 
Stakeholder Partnership: Partner closely with stakeholders across Global Supply Chain to align local execution with global planning standards, processes, and strategic priorities.

• 
Data & Insights: Transform complex planning data into clear, actionable insights that support global decision-making and improve cost, service and operational performance.

• 
Performance Management: Develop, maintain and optimize KPIs, reporting and dashboards to monitor planning performance, identify bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• 
Have 5-7+ years of experience within supply chain planning, planning excellence, process improvement, supply chain analytics, S&OP/IBP, or related areas.

• 
Have solid experience driving process improvements, standardization initiatives, or transformation projects in a complex international supply chain environment.

• 
Are comfortable translating data and business needs into actionable insights, recommendations, and scalable solutions.

• 
Thrive in a stakeholder-facing role and have a proven ability to influence and drive change across functions, regions, and organizational levels.

• 
Combine a strategic mindset with a hands-on approach and enjoy turning ideas and opportunities into tangible improvements.

• 
Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

• 
Experience from MedTech or another complex, regulated industry is an advantage.

Above all, you bring curiosity, ownership, and a passion for continuous improvement. You are naturally proactive, challenge the status quo constructively, and enjoy collaborating with others to turn insights into tangible business improvements. You are equally comfortable working with detailed analyses and broader strategic initiatives, and you thrive in environments where you can make a visible impact on processes and performance.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

**_Are you ready to shape the future of banking? Then join us at the forefront of technological innovation, harnessing the power of Generative AI to revolutionize internal processes within the Risk and Compliance organization. Your journey into the future of banking starts here!

_Danske Bank is seeking a Generative AI Engineer (Full-Stack Developer) with a keen interest in Generative AI to join our dynamic and innovative Generative AI squads within the Risk and Compliance Tribe.

The Risk and Compliance Tribe has a unique blend of business experts and IT specialists working together in agile teams. In our organization, teams are self-managed, entrusted to make key decisions, and crucial in driving end-to-end product and service delivery. Through these efforts, you will empower our colleagues and turn cutting-edge technology into real business impact.

**Location and eligibility

**

**How To Apply

**We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply early. Submit your CV and a brief cover letter via the Danske Bank careers site. If you have any questions, contact Aleksandar Milacic, Chapter Lead, at amila@danskebank.dk.

Turn photonic quantum processors into real-world value

At Sparrow Quantum, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of light-matter interfaces for quantum technology to enable state-of-the-art scalable photonic quantum systems.

Sparrow Quantum is building universal photonic quantum processors based on deterministic quantum emitters. We are looking for a Quantum Applications Scientist to build on Sparrow’s work on use cases and algorithms and to help push the frontier demonstrating what photonic quantum can do for real end users.

You will act as the bridge between our theory, experimental, and business teams and our end users. You will take an end user's problem, work out how our hardware can address it, and turn it into a concrete plan that you help execute together with the teams.

This is a technical role with a clear focus on applications. You have the theoretical depth to develop applications yourself, with an eye for the quantum algorithms behind them, the experimental insight to discuss feasibility with our experimentalists, and the overview to translate between what end users need and what our hardware can do. You are expected to take initiative and move from a loosely defined question to a workable solution.

Responsibilities of the role

• 
Identify and develop use cases and quantum algorithms for our demonstrator, from initial end-user needs to proof of concept

• 
Translate end-user problems into well-defined computational tasks, and assess where our hardware can offer value

• 
Discuss feasibility with our experimental team, and feedback which hardware capabilities matter most for applications

• 
Run and guide simulations of algorithms and use cases to benchmark performance and compare against classical approaches

• 
Join end-user meetings initiated by the business team as the technical bridge, and turn results into clear recommendations

• 
Work with the business team on proposals, demonstrations, partnerships, and funding applications

• 
Represent Sparrow Quantum at conferences, workshops, and end-user meetings

In brief, we offer a unique opportunity for a talented Quantum Applications Scientist to collaborate with world-leading professionals in the field. Your work will shape how end users apply our quantum hardware and help steer our technology towards the problems that matter most.

Required qualifications

• 
PhD in quantum physics or a closely related field, with a strong theoretical foundation, ideally with postdoctoral or industry experience

• 
Good understanding of quantum computing use cases and where they may offer an advantage, e.g. in optimization, machine learning or simulation, with an interest in the underlying algorithms

• 
Worked alongside experimentalists, giving you a solid sense of what is experimentally feasible

• 
Solid programming skills, e.g. in Python, for simulating and benchmarking algorithms

• 
Proven ability to communicate complex technical ideas to non-specialists, including end users and business stakeholders

Nice-to-have qualifications

• 
Experience with quantum photonics, quantum optics or photonic quantum computing

• 
Experience working with industry partners, customers or end users on applied projects

• 
Experience leading projects or supervising junior researchers

• 
Experience with collaborative R&D projects or funding applications

• 
Knowledge of boson sampling, measurement-based or fusion-based quantum computing

• 
A track record of publications in quantum technologies

Additionally, we expect that you thrive in a collaborative work environment and are inspired by the chance to contribute to groundbreaking advancements in quantum computing.

Desired abilities & competencies

• 
Overview: you keep the big picture in view and connect technical detail to what matters for the end user and for Sparrow Quantum.

• 
Translator: you are equally comfortable discussing algorithms with theorists, feasibility with experimentalists and value with end users.

• 
Proactive and solution-oriented: you spot opportunities, take the first step, and come back with options rather than obstacles.

• 
Constructive challenger: you are confident challenging assumptions, just as open to having your own challenged, and look for solutions that work both for the end user and for our hardware.

What we offer

• 
Passionate international team and high individual impact: Join a high-performance team of dynamic and highly motivated international professionals working towards photonic quantum computing. Your innovative ideas, unique perspectives, and unwavering drive to succeed are essential to the team and will have a direct impact on the future of our organization.

• 
Cutting-edge projects and world-renowned collaborators: Collaborate with world-renowned companies and researchers, working on cutting-edge projects that will shape the future of quantum technology. You will contribute to scientific publication, represent the company at conferences, and have the possibility of travelling to our collaborators for new insights and knowledge sharing.

• 
Personal and professional growth: Expect a steep learning curve in a supportive environment at the border between research and industry. Our commitment to your growth and development is reflected in our supportive culture, which includes group-based knowledge transfer, skill development, and opportunities for training and mentorship.

• 
Attractive compensation and career advancement opportunities: Receive a salary that is competitive and commensurate with your qualifications, with ample opportunities to advance your career and achieve your professional goals.

• 
Inclusive and positive work culture: Become part of a positive and inclusive work culture where we build meaningful relationships and celebrate one another and our achievements. Our work culture emphasizes work-life balance, with generous vacation time, flexible working hours with up to 10-20% working from home, lunch paid by the company, and a focus on employee well-being.

How to apply

If you share our passion for delivering a real-world impact through the development of unique quantum photonic technology and have the skills we believe are essential for future Sparrows, we would love to hear from you.

We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace at Sparrow Quantum and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities.

How to apply: Scroll down to apply with your CV and a short cover letter (in English).

Application deadline: November 15.

Starting date: As soon as possible.

Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis

Short-listed candidates will be invited for an in-person interview in Copenhagen. Travel and accommodation will be covered.

For questions, contact Larissa Vertchenko.

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company dedicated to advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies. We are recognized globally for our high-performance single-photon sources and our foundational contributions to the quantum internet and quantum computing.

Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into

the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food — we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.

Everything we do is about **Making Better Happen™.

**About The Role

We are looking for a Global ESG Engineer to join AAK’s Global Operations team and help drive the implementation of our operational ESG strategy across our global manufacturing network.

As the technical ESG expert within Global Operations, you will translate AAK’s sustainability ambitions into practical engineering standards, measurable KPIs and improvement programmes. Your focus will be on identifying opportunities to improve energy efficiency, reduce carbon emissions, optimise water and waste, and improve the overall resource efficiency of our operations.

Working closely with Global Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing Excellence, Procurement, Digital & IT, EHS, Sustainability and regional teams, you will develop consistent approaches to ESG performance, strengthen the quality of our data and support sites in delivering measurable environmental and financial benefits.

This is a hands-on, global role where you will combine technical expertise, data-driven insight and stakeholder management to create scalable solutions across AAK’s manufacturing network. You will also play an important role in developing digital ESG reporting capabilities and embedding continuous improvement into our operations.

**Responsibilities

• Identify and prioritise ESG improvement opportunities across AAK’s manufacturing network, with a focus on energy, carbon, water, waste and resource efficiency.

• Co-develop and implement global engineering standards, technical specifications, methodologies and best practices that support consistent ESG performance.

• Work with manufacturing sites to assess technical solutions, develop business cases and quantify the environmental, energy and financial benefits of improvement projects.

• Translate global ESG targets into practical site-level roadmaps, KPIs, improvement projects and implementation plans.

• Drive the deployment of energy monitoring, carbon tracking and digital ESG data solutions to improve data quality, transparency and decision-making.

• Collaborate with Global Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing Excellence, Procurement, Digital & IT, EHS and Sustainability to embed ESG improvements into capital projects and daily operations.

• Use operational data and performance analysis to identify trends, improvement opportunities and priorities across regions.

• Track project progress, verify delivered benefits and share best practices and lessons learned across the global manufacturing network.

• Support the development of consistent ESG reporting and data management processes, ensuring reliable information for internal and external reporting requirements.

• Stay up to date with emerging technologies, ESG standards and regulatory developments, translating relevant changes into practical improvements for AAK’s operations.

**About You

• Degree in Chemical, Process, Energy, Environmental, Carbon & Net Zero Engineering or a related technical discipline, with 5–8+ years of relevant industry experience.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, industrial utilities, energy systems and operational environments, ideally with experience across multiple sites.

• Proven experience delivering ESG, sustainability, energy efficiency or carbon reduction programmes within manufacturing.

• Strong expertise in energy monitoring and reduction methodologies, with knowledge of approaches such as Pinch Analysis and experience calculating energy, carbon and financial savings.

• Good understanding of carbon accounting, Net Zero and ESG reporting frameworks, including GHG Protocol, CSRD, ESRS, SBTi, CDP and ESG Taxonomy.

• Experience developing engineering standards, technical specifications, project business cases, payback calculations and relevant engineering calculations.

• Strong data and digital capability, including experience with KPI reporting systems, data collection and dashboarding tools such as Power BI, Tableau or similar.

• Excellent project management, stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across regions and organisational levels.

• Structured, analytical and hands-on, with the credibility to engage both with site teams and senior leadership.

• Fluent in English and willing to travel internationally, with approximately 20–30% travel expected.

**In return AAK offers

• Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability.

• In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team.

• AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths.

• You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach.

• Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

**About AAK

Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable. At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and more than 20 production facilities worldwide. Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

AAK is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms.

**Welcome to Generation CE

**You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions.

As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations

• translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes

• ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends

• overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives

• strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams

• promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience

About the Role:

QuNorth is looking for a Quantum Error Correction (QEC) Lead to help develop and lead our collaborative Quantum Error Correction program, in addition to participating in other aspects of operationalizing Magne, QuNorth’s Neutral Atom quantum computer, in a fast-paced but stable startup environment.

QuNorth is a new Nordic Hub for quantum exploration, providing the region’s enterprises, researchers, and startups with the capability to test, learn, and build on Magne, a world-leading Level 2 quantum computer. With strong backing from EIFO and the Novo Nordisk Foundation, QuNorth will operate Magne as a shared platform for Nordic industries, research organisations, and start-ups. Our aim is to provide the access, tools, expertise, and support needed to explore new quantum applications across all relevant areas, including, but not limited to, life sciences, innovative materials, biochemistry, and AI.

Magne’s physical layer, developed by Atom Computing, includes 1200+ Ytterbium-171 atoms, serving as physical qubits with all-to-all connectivity. It can be operated seamlessly in logical mode enabled by Microsoft, providing tens of logical qubits depending on QEC code. Magne can also be operated in physical mode with mid-circuit measurement and feedforward, which in conjunction with its all-to-all connectivity at scale turns Magne into an excellent platform for exploration of novel QEC techniques, unconstrained by “chip topology”. We envision QEC projects and broader QEC-related partnerships to be a strong component of QuNorth’s portfolio. Working directly with the CTO, and interfacing with the CPO team and QuNorth’s users and partners, the QEC Lead will help shape this key component of the QuNorth portfolio. This role will, at least initially, be mostly a technical leadership role, rather than a managerial position.

We are a small and committed team working to build QuNorth from the ground up as a reliable and transparent organization that contributes to the long-term strength of the Nordic quantum computing ecosystem.

Your Responsibilities:

The successful candidate will eagerly engage in many of the following directions:

• Lead QuNorth’s technical work on quantum error correction, including strategy, architecture assessment, simulation, benchmarking, resource estimation, and roadmap development.

• Evaluate and compare QEC codes, decoding approaches, logical gate schemes, error models, and fault-tolerant architectures.

• Work with hardware, software, and theory collaborators to connect QEC requirements and assumptions to realistic device constraints.

• Help identify which QEC approaches are most relevant to QuNorth’s mission and which are not.

• Work closely with QuNorth’s CTO and Quantum Applications and Algorithms Lead to explore the interplay between applications, algorithms, QCVV, compilation, QEC, noise, error mitigation, and logical-mode operation, including opportunities for integration and co-design.

• Represent QuNorth in collaborations, including with universities, research institutes, startups, and enterprises.

• Contribute to proposals, grant applications, reports, publications, presentations, and internal documents.

• Help recruit, mentor, and coordinate future team members working on QEC, quantum architecture, simulation, and related topics.

• Participate in broader company-building work, including technical due diligence, collaborator or partner discussions, product strategy, documentation, and operational tasks.

• Use AI tools effectively and responsibly to accelerate research, coding, literature review, writing, planning, analysis, operations, and internal workflows.

• Help establish a high standard for scientific rigor, clear communication, and effective execution within the company.

Your Experience and Qualifications:

We expect strong candidates to have many of the following:

• A PhD or equivalent experience required in quantum information, quantum computing, physics, computer science, mathematics, electrical engineering, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in QEC beyond PhD.

• Deep understanding of quantum error correction and fault-tolerant quantum computing.

• Deep familiarity with topics such as surface codes, qLDPC codes, color codes, bosonic codes, subsystem codes, concatenated codes, holographic codes, and other conventional or emerging QEC approaches.

• ‘Hands-on’ experience with decoding algorithms, error models, threshold analysis, logical error rates, resource estimation, and architecture-level tradeoffs.

• Deep familiarity with QCVV techniques, including benchmarking approaches.

• Deep familiarity with protocols for mitigation and characterization of noise and error, and their relationship with QEC and relevant thresholds.

• Strong programming experience, preferably in Python or similar scientific computing environments, with experience developing simulations, analysis workflows, notebooks, benchmarking tools, or research software.

• Experience collaborating across disciplines with comfort, especially between theory, software, and experimental teams.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfort working in an early-stage environment where priorities evolve and everyone contributes beyond their formal job title.

• Practical experience using AI tools such as LLMs, coding assistants, literature tools, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled analysis environments.

• Good judgment about when AI tools are useful, when they are unreliable, and how to verify their outputs.

The Team:

The position is based in our new offices at Rønnegade 6 in Copenhagen, where Magne is also currently being built. You will be part of the Technology team under the CTO, and will interact closely with the Product team under the CPO and the rest of QuNorth as well.

Like many start-ups, we are building QuNorth as we go. You will join a very entrepreneurial team, driven by curiosity about the technology, with a desire to make an impact while working in a fun and engaging workplace. As an early employee, you will be an important contributor to building this environment along with us.

What We Offer:

A unique opportunity to be part of standing up and operating a quantum computing company with strong backers, in modern offices located centrally in the Innovation District Copenhagen with convenient public transport and lunch service.

Comprehensive remuneration package, including benefits that support an environment where people can grow and do their best work.

This position will be based in Copenhagen, which offers a rare combination of international outlook, strong quantum and deep-tech ecosystem, and excellent quality of life, consistently ranked amongst the most liveable cities in the world.

We’re looking for a Legal Engineer to join our Product team in Copenhagen. Someone with a strong legal foundation who is excited about AI, technology, and finding better ways to do legal work. You’ll get hands-on with our product, work on real legal problems, and help us build AI-powered tools that lawyers can actually rely on.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**As a Legal Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of law, AI, and product. You'll join our Product team and work closely with Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales.

This is a hands-on role: rather than practising law, you'll use your legal expertise to evaluate AI-generated legal work, figure out where and why it falls short, and turn real legal problems into scalable AI-powered workflows. It's a good fit if you like getting deep into legal detail but also enjoy stepping back to ask why something works and how it could work better.

**What You'll Do

**

• Evaluate and improve legal AI quality: test AI-generated legal research and analysis for correctness, completeness, reasoning, and source selection. Investigate where outputs fall short and turn findings into actionable input for Product and Engineering.

• Turn legal problems into AI-powered workflows: break down how lawyers actually perform a task, define what a good outcome looks like, and help develop, test, and refine workflows that solve it at scale.

• Bring UK legal expertise into product development: apply your knowledge of UK law, legal sources, and lawyer workflows to how we evaluate and build our products.

• Work on complex customer problems: partner with Customer Success and Sales on cases needing deeper legal expertise — understand the underlying problem, shape practical solutions, and feed what you learn back into Product.

• Help lawyers work effectively with AI: build workflows and examples that help customers get real value from AI in their legal work, and flag recurring needs that could inform future product decisions.

**What You’ll Bring

**We’re primarily looking for strong legal expertise and judgement. You don’t need a background in engineering, AI, or product development — those are things you can develop in the role.

• Advanced legal education or professional legal qualification, with a strong foundation in UK law gained through your education and/or professional training. You should be able to independently research, analyse, and assess UK complex and abstract legal questions.

• A couple of years of hands-on legal experience from a law firm, in-house legal team, public institution, or comparable legal environment.

• Strong experience with legal research and analysis, and the ability to work independently with complex legal questions and source material.

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to assess the quality of legal work, identify weaknesses or unsupported conclusions, and explain clearly what could be improved.

**Nice to have

**You don’t need to tick every box below. These are a plus, not requirements:

• Hands-on experience using AI tools for legal work, such as legal research, drafting, contract analysis, or document review.

• Familiarity with prompting, LLM evaluations, or systematically testing AI-generated outputs.

• Experience with document-heavy or structured legal workflows, such as due diligence, contract review, regulatory analysis, or multi-jurisdictional research.

• Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders and translating complex legal needs into practical solutions.

• Exposure to product development, user testing, or workflow design.

• Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or legal systems, particularly both common-law and civil-law systems.

• Basic technical or data literacy, such as structured data, APIs, advanced spreadsheets, or simple scripting.

• Additional language skills beyond English.

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in our Copenhagen HQ and remotely from Hamburg, Zurich and London. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

**Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.

• Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.

• Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.

• Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.

• Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.

• Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

**You’re a great match if

**

• You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team

• You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off

• You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them

• You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team

• You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

**Nice to have

**

• Experience working on live games

**Requirements For Any Job At Triband

**

• You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture

• You value a positive work environment

• You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place
